name: Creel Creek · Terrain Ride
description: Ride the 29.13 km Creel Creek route: a long opening climb, rolling high ground, and a downhill return. Segments advance by distance traveled. Power is the primary goal; cadence is a guide. Adjust resistance to meet the target. Set your FTP in Rider Profile.

source.method: 100 m elevation samples, five-point smoothing, approximately 1 km sections; grade thresholds -1%, 1.5%, 5%

steps.label: Steady terrain · 0.0–4.0 km
steps.cue: Find a comfortable rhythm. Gradually add load.

steps.label: Climb · 4.0–10.0 km
steps.cue: Add resistance and keep your pedal stroke smooth.

steps.label: Steep climb · 10.0–11.0 km
steps.cue: Hold a controlled effort. Keep your shoulders relaxed as the trail steepens.

steps.label: Steady terrain · 11.0–12.0 km
steps.cue: Find a comfortable rhythm. Keep your effort steady through the changing scenery.

steps.label: Downhill spin · 12.0–14.0 km
steps.cue: Release resistance. Let your breathing settle and keep your pedals controlled.

steps.label: Climb · 14.0–15.0 km
steps.cue: Add resistance and keep your pedal stroke smooth.

steps.label: Downhill spin · 15.0–16.0 km
steps.cue: Release resistance. Let your breathing settle and keep your pedals controlled.

steps.label: Climb · 16.0–18.0 km
steps.cue: Last substantial climb. Finish with control.

steps.label: Downhill spin · 18.0–26.0 km
steps.cue: Release resistance. Let your breathing settle and keep your pedals controlled.

steps.label: Steady terrain · 26.0–29.0 km
steps.cue: Ease the resistance down. Keep your pedals smooth on the return to the finish.

steps.label: Downhill spin · 29.0–29.1 km
steps.cue: Ease the resistance down. Keep your pedals smooth on the return to the finish.
